# Banting Buddy 2.0

> The Banting & LCHF app for real low-carb living. Track 50g net carbs, scan supermarket barcodes, browse meal plans — 100% offline. Free with ads on Google Play, optional ad removal for 1, 3 or 12 months, no account needed.

## What it does

- Daily Macro & Carb Tracker: real-time bars for 50g net carb ceiling, fats, protein. Free.
- Smart Barcode Scanner: on-device scan flags hidden sugars, non-Banting ingredients, net carbs. No internet needed.
- Curated Meal Plans: Banting-compliant LCHF library matched to remaining macros.
- Intelligent Grocery Lists: category-organised, generated from meal plan.
- Daily Motivation: quote on dashboard.
- Privacy by Design: all logs stored on-device. No sign-up, no cloud sync.

## Banting basics

- Banting = Low Carb High Fat (LCHF), pioneered by Prof Tim Noakes / Real Meal Revolution. Net carbs under 50g/day.
- Banting vs keto: similar, Banting allows 50g/day vs 20-30g strict keto, focuses on whole unprocessed foods.
- Hidden carbs in sauces, dressings, packaged foods are the #1 reason tracking matters.
- Works offline at store/gym. Free with ads; ad removal for 1, 3 or 12 months.

## FAQ

- Best Banting app? Banting Buddy 2.0 is built specifically for 50g limit, barcode scanning, LCHF plans, offline privacy.
- Works without internet? Yes, tracker, scanner, planner, lists run on-device after download.
- How does macro tracker work? Visual progress bars, one-tap meal add, weight progress.
- Free? Yes, free download with ads, all features included. Optional ad removal for 1, 3 or 12 months.
- Supermarket scanner? Yes, worldwide barcodes, flags sugars, shows net carbs offline.
- Banting vs keto? 50g vs 20-30g, whole foods focus, calibrated for Banting macros.

## Who it's for

- New Banters starting weight loss, seasoned LCHF followers, South African shoppers checking Woolworths/Checkers/Pick n Pay products, privacy-conscious health users, offline users.
